title: Carafe of Water
summary: Throw as an Action up to 60 ft. Creates Water and makes creatures in the splash Wet for 3 turns.

fields.Wet: Resist Fire and prevent Burning. Cold and Lightning vulnerability applies unless an existing resistance instead cancels it. Becoming Wet breaks ordinary Invisibility and removes coatings from equipped weapons.
fields.Base value: 5 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.
fields.Throw: Action. Throw up to 60 ft to create a permanent Water surface with a 7 ft radius. Creatures in the splash become Wet for 3 turns.

changes: Added reviewed native BG3 gameplay and pinned item and dependency revisions. Expanded the card from the pinned item and linked gameplay evidence.
